name: Peninsula Gardens Live Rosin Disposable | Blumosa
description: Bred by Mosca seeds. A perfect pairing of Blue Cookies and Mimosa. Her flavor profile is orange citrus heavy with some doughy cream from the blue cookies to back it up. A nice strong high that that is very well balanced for day or night.
